description: ColaMD's own commands need no permission entries; what is listed here is what the shell borrows from plugins: native dialogs for open/save and the file manager, plus the platform basics. Every window matches: they are all created by this app and all load the same frontend, and scoping this to "main" left the windows opened by File > New Window without core permissions, which made them deaf to every menu command and impossible to drag (2026-10-09).
